street_photogrammetry.limitations: Two vanishing directions and four points on the 2014 street corner, using EXIF 24 mm equivalent. The tower base is partly obscured. Results are estimates.

estimate: Street width 27.84 m from the structural parcel. Four same-facade points produce an approximate 9.75 m belt. Projected roof displacement of tens of image pixels makes the tower location uncertain by a few metres; an estimate from the photo ray at local X near 14 m places the green crown around 12 m behind the street. The heritage street elevation faces towards the northwest-facing roadway boundary. The service yard and the separate taller 30-storey headquarters remain outside the drawing.
